Results.ReviewText: My husband bought this for our small yard. He was able to get it started once, but when he turned it off to change attachments, he couldn’t get it running again. I’ve tried many times, instructions in hand, to get this thing running, and it’s like it has been designed to be impossible. Pull start, choke that you have to switch while it’s just turned over to “run” then another switch to flip or the thing stops running after a minute anyway. I wish I could return it but it’s out of warranty because we assumed it was human error that was the problem, which is a pretty good racket if you like fleecing people with motor technology that was outdated in the 1990s.
